description: The app lets ChatGPT retrieve read-only fleet information such as live vehicle status, locations, trip summaries, travel distance, stoppages, idling, inactive vehicles, overspeed events, AC and digital-port sensor usage, temperature reports, fuel fill/drain summaries, route playback, system logs, and product help documentation. Several tools can render ChatGPT Apps SDK widgets, including fleet maps, playback maps, report dashboards, and documentation cards.

defaultPrompt: Where are my vehicles right now?
